design_description: CDRH3 WGGMGPYWMD (3 subs from trastuzumab). coworker, enumerated. 3 subs; keeps W99/G103/Y105. StaB-ddG 0.17+-0.17 kcal/mol (1.3x WT, within assay noise). Refold: phi(104)=-78deg (proline-compatible), CDRH3 2.23A from the four epitope hotspots vs 2.63A for wild-type.

CDRH3 WGGKGPYWMD (3 subs from trastuzumab). coworker, enumerated. 3 subs; keeps W99/G103/Y105. StaB-ddG 0.42 kcal/mol (2.0x WT); best coworker-model KD 0.77 nM. Refold: phi(104)=-64deg, CDRH3 2.31A from hotspots.

CDRH3 STSTYFYAFD (6 subs from trastuzumab). RFD4-Proteina generative. 6 subs. THE ONLY DESIGN RETAINING Phe104, hedging the F104P risk shared across the coworker set; also keeps Y105. StaB-ddG 1.35 kcal/mol.

CDRH3 SLGSADYAFD (6 subs from trastuzumab). RFD4-Proteina generative. 6 subs. Independent mutation pattern (no F104P, no A106W, one fewer CDR3 Trp). StaB-ddG 0.42 kcal/mol; cleanest developability scored (5 liabilities vs wild-type 8).
